## Setting up two-factor authentication

In order to protect your account, we recommend enabling two-factor authentication. Once it is on, signing in from a new device requires a six-digit code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.

- Open Settings and choose Security.

- Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, Authy, or any app that supports TOTP.

- Enter the code the app shows to confirm. If the code is rejected, your phone's clock may be to far out of sync; enable automatic time in the phone's settings and try again.

- Save the recovery codes somewhere safe. Each code works once and is the only way back in if you lose your phone.
